title: Panglao orders midnight closure of bars, videoke joints

blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY— Bars, pubs, nightclubs, karaoke and videoke bars, and other similar nighttime entertainment establishments in Panglao, Bohol must close to customers by midnight under a new executive order issued by Mayor Edgardo “Boy” Arcay on Monday. Arcay issued Executive Order No. 44, Series of 2026, citing the need to maintain peace and order, public safety, cleanliness, and a healthy environment for residents, workers, and visitors in the tourism-dependent municipality. The order covers establishments whose principal or substantial business involves selling alcoholic beverages and/or nighttime entertainment.
